content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD wetting-drying mask update file (header L3 'FILE masks.F', BSD license L5-43) containing the single SUBROUTINE UPDATE_MASK (L51, note L47 says mask is also updated in the fluxes subroutine). Allocates temporaries MASKtmp/MASK9tmp/ETAtmp (L63-64), exchanges MASK/MASK9 ghost cells under PARALLEL (L69-70), copies MASKtmp=MASK (L73) and zeroes Dmass (L76); under UseEtaScreen sets EtaScreen=ETA(I,J) and ETAtmp=EtaScreen (L79-80). Main sweep over J=Jbeg-2..Jend+2, I=Ibeg-2..Iend+2 (L83-164): flooding — where MASK_STRUC==1 and cell dry (MASK<1), re-wet MASKtmp=1 if any of the four wet neighbors has Eta above the cell's surface (UseEtaScreen variant compares neighbor Eta with EtaScreen(I,J), L90-104; default variant additionally re-wets when Eta(I,J)>-Depth(I,J) 'for rainfall case' L107-109 and compares neighbor Eta with Eta(I,J), L111-125); drying — a wet cell with Eta<-Depth becomes MASKtmp=0 (L129-130) and the interior mass defect Dmass accumulates (ETAtmp-ETA)*DX*DY (CARTESIAN scalar L136, variable-grid L138); version 3.4 commented-out lines show ETA rewriting was removed (L75, L132, L169). Unless IGNORE_BIG_SLOPE, dry cells get locally flattened interface depths DepthX/DepthY from cell-centered Depth (L155-160, comments L145-151 citing 01/21/2012 truncation and Choi's Thacker-bowl accuracy caveat 07/03/2016). Then MASK=MASKtmp (L167), EtaScreen=ETAtmp under UseEtaScreen (L172); second sweep J=Jbeg-1..Jend+1 builds MASK9tmp: 1 everywhere if VISCOSITY_BREAKING ('dont use mask9 for viscosity breaking', L177-179), else 9-point product of MASK (L181-183) zeroed where ABS(Eta)/MAX(DEPTH,MinDepthFrc)>SWE_ETA_DEP switches to SWE (L184-186); MASK9=MASK9tmp (L193), multiplied by MaskVessel under DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL (L196); PARALLEL re-exchange (L200-201); temporaries deallocated (L204-205). Under CHECK_MASS_CONSERVATION (L207-248): WetArea summed over wet interior cells (L210-224), MPI_ALLREDUCE sums of WetArea and Dmass (L227-230), DwetEta=Dmass/Max(DX*DY,WetArea) (L235, spherical DX(1,1)*DY(1,1) L237), and ETA on wet cells reduced by DwetEta (L240-244) with note that eta is exchanged at bc in Main.F (L245).
entities: SUBROUTINE UPDATE_MASK loc 51; USE GLOBAL loc 52; USE VESSEL_MODULE loc 54 (VESSEL)
calls: call phi_int_exch(MASK) loc 69; phi_int_exch(MASK9) loc 70 (PARALLEL, pre-update)
CALL PHI_INT_EXCH(MASK) loc 200; PHI_INT_EXCH(MASK9) loc 201 (PARALLEL, post-update)

verbatim_spans.text: !       note that mask also be updated in fluxes subroutine
! In Makefile, define -DIGNORE_BIG_SLOPE to ignore big slopes
! dont use mask9 for viscosity breaking
!   now check_mass_conservation is a general setting after tests
! then eta will be exchanged at bc in Main.F

unresolved: L79 'EtaScreen=ETA(I,J)' uses scalar indices I,J outside any loop (whole-array intent implied by ETAtmp=EtaScreen at L80) — under UseEtaScreen this assigns only one element whose I,J values are leftovers from the caller; likely intended EtaScreen=ETA.

Dmass accumulation (L136/L138) uses (ETAtmp-ETA) but the version-3.4 line that made ETAtmp differ from ETA (L132 'ETAtmp(I,J)=MinDepth-Depth(I,J)') is commented out; in the non-UseEtaScreen build ETAtmp is never assigned before use, so the summand is undefined-minus-ETA; in the UseEtaScreen build ETAtmp=EtaScreen (L80).

MASK9tmp is assigned only over Jbeg-1..Jend+1 x Ibeg-1..Iend+1 (L175-176) but MASK9=MASK9tmp copies the whole allocated array (L193), leaving outer ghost rows of MASK9 from uninitialized MASK9tmp memory until PHI_INT_EXCH (L201, PARALLEL only).
MASK9tmp is INTEGER (L57) but assigned ZERO (L185), a REAL(SP) named constant from PARAM — implicit conversion.

Flood sweep reads MASK(I-1..I+1,J-1..J+1) at I=Ibeg-2..Iend+2 (L83-84), touching indices down to Ibeg-3 only via DepthX(I+1,J) at L157 style writes — boundary index extent relies on ghost width Nghost>=3.

CHECK_MASS_CONSERVATION correction subtracts DwetEta from all wet cells every call (L240-244) — global mass redistribution; comment L208 says it is 'a general setting after tests' though it remains behind an ifdef.
